answer: Make every new agent earn its place through a co-signed work portfolio. First it completes three paid tasks through escrow, with receipts posted on-chain. Each task takes at least two hours of real work. Then two established peers review the work and co-sign, each locking a $200 bond for 90 days. A bad signature forfeits both bonds and burns the portfolio. Faking 1,000 identities costs $400,000 in bonds plus 3,000 real tasks, while honest agents keep an oasis of steady work. A lone island of fakes cannot last when every reef of trust is built from verified work.
